description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo operation to query the certificate information for a specified domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo查询指定域名证书信息
name: DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

CertDomainName.description_en: The domain name that is associated with the certificate

CertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate

CertLife.description_en: The validity period of the certificate. The unit can be months or years

CertOrg.description_en: The certificate authority (CA) that issued the certificate

CertRegion.description_en: The region where the certificate is used

CertType.description_en:
The type of the certificate.

cas: An Alibaba Cloud Security certificate.

upload: A custom certificate that you uploaded
CertType.description_zh:
证书类型。

cas：云盾证书。
upload：自定义上传

SSLProtocol.description_en:
The HTTPS status.

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
SSLProtocol.description_zh:
HTTPS开启状态。

on：已开启。

off：未开启

SSLPub.description_en: The public key of the certificate

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate.

success: The certificate is active.

checking: The system is checking whether the domain name is accelerated by Alibaba Cloud DCDN.

cname_error: The domain name is not mapped to Alibaba Cloud DCDN.

domain_invalid: The domain name contains invalid characters.

unsupport_wildcard: Wildcard domain names are not supported.

applying: The certificate is being applied for.

get_token_timeout: The Certificate Signing Request (CSR) timed out.

check_token_timeout: The verification timed out.

get_cert_timeout: The request to obtain the certificate timed out.

failed: The certificate application failed
Status.description_zh:
证书状态。

success：已生效。

checking：检测域名是否在阿里云全站加速。

cname_error：域名没有切到阿里云全站加速。

domain_invalid：域名包含非法字符。

unsupport_wildcard：不支持泛域名。

applying：证书申请中。

get_token_timeout：证书申请超时。

check_token_timeout：校验超时。

get_cert_timeout：获取证书超时。

failed：证书申请失败
